# Procedure

Inspect WSDL/XSD, service descriptors, generated code and generator command. Preserve namespaces, optional/nillable elements, fault semantics and serialization. Test timeout/fault/invalid payload and real endpoint separately from mocks. Record contract changes for renewed approval.

# Contract

Read docs/STACK.md and the selected change inputs. Preserve source/requirement references. Persist outputs to changes/CHANGE-ID. Use templates where relevant. Do not modify controls or self-approve. Report blockers with the decision needed and affected artifacts.
